Name: (CP) Blue Eggs and Golden Mayo (Now with extra Ostrich)
Description:
[center][b][url=https://ko-fi.com/6480k]If you like my work, consider leaving a tip ♥[/url]﻿﻿[/b][/center]
Blue chickens now lay blue eggs, which can hatch into more blue chickens. You can make mayo. They are just a tiny bit more profitable than large white/brown eggs. You can use blue eggs in any egg recipe.

Golden eggs will make golden mayo, which sells for the same price as three gold-quality mayos (its vanilla product).

Thanks to popular request, Ostrich eggs also make Ostrich mayonnaise. These keep the original quality of the egg, to match vanilla profit.

You may enable or disable any of the mayonnaise types through the config menu. I recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to control your config choices.

Uses Content Patcher on SDV version 1.6.

Inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5875]Blue Eggs[/url], but remade from scratch.

Installation instructions:
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]
- Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]
- Download this mod and unzip it into your mod folder
- Done!
